6392.title: Repository sync silently loses issues outside its first page
6392.rootCauseOneLine: A single creation-descending issue page is treated as a complete repository snapshot and replaces all cached rows.
6392.proposedFix: Choose complete cursor pagination with an explicit resource budget and all-pages-before-replacement safety, or expose bounded-snapshot completeness consistently in the UI, RPC, and CLI.
6392.caveats: Offline plugin RPC reproduction using real SQLite and a synthetic external GraphQL boundary; no desktop/browser or live GitHub verification. No automatic PR because complete pagination would change the documented bounded-fetch policy.
